briefings.title: Trump's Treasury chief on prices, AI and Iran | The Axios Show
briefings.tldr: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent defended the administration's economic record amid public cost-of-living frustrations, outlined aggressive economic pressure campaigns against Iran, and discussed risks and regulation surrounding the U.S. AI boom.

briefings.title: Jensen Huang says the AI doomers have it wrong
briefings.tldr: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang dismissed extreme warnings about artificial intelligence as "complete nonsense," arguing that AI is driving unprecedented productivity and net job creation rather than eliminating human labor.

briefings.title: A new era of discovery: AI and the frontiers of science with Demis Hassabis
briefings.tldr: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis predicts that Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) will arrive between 2029 and 2031, ushering in a transformative "singularity" era marked by self-improving code, agentic systems, and a massive 100x acceleration of scientific and medical discovery.

briefings.title: OpenAI’s warning: Washington isn’t ready for what’s coming
briefings.tldr: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman warns that the next generation of AI models will represent a "significant step forward," potentially enabling career-defining scientific discoveries while simultaneously creating urgent, "world-shaking" cybersecurity and biosecurity risks that Washington is currently unprepared to manage.

briefings.title: Jamie Dimon on Trump, the war in Iran, and Epstein | The Axios Show
briefings.tldr: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon warns that geopolitical risks are at their highest level since World War II, while domestic success is threatened by a "softening" of American grit and a corporate leadership class too "chicken shit" to engage in honest policy debate.

briefings.title: Anduril's Palmer Luckey on AI, nukes, and the war in Iran | The Axios Show
briefings.tldr: Anduril Industries is disrupting the traditional defense model by using private capital to rapidly develop autonomous systems, with founder Palmer Luckey advocating for the U.S. to transition from "world’s police" to the "world’s gun store" through high-scale, AI-driven weaponry.
